MegCity’s Personal Training sessions offer young athletes a direct path to faster growth, technical precision, and mental confidence. Designed for players ages 7–17, these one-on-one or small group sessions are fully customized to meet each player’s current level and goals—whether they’re new to the game, prepping for tryouts, or chasing elite development.

Led by nationally certified, experienced coaches, each session provides focused attention, immediate feedback, and measurable progress.

Our personal training sessions are structured to deliver high repetition, technical detail, and intensity:

  • Dynamic Warm-Up & Stretching

  • Ball Mastery & Footwork

  • Passing & Receiving

  • 1v1 Attacking & Defending

  • Finishing & Shooting Mechanics

  • Small-Sided or Fully Opposed Play

  • Mental Conditioning & Game IQ

  • Cool-Down & Performance Review

  • Training recording via Veo 

Each session runs 60–75 minutes. Packages are available for players seeking regular weekly sessions or intensive prep.

Players in our personal training program benefit from:

  • Rapid skill improvement and increased technical confidence

  • More purposeful touches on the ball

  • Sharper decision-making and game speed

  • Physical conditioning and endurance

MegCity Clinics are FREE, high-energy training sessions designed to introduce and sharpen core soccer skills in a fun, supportive, and structured environment. Perfect for players ages 7–17 of all skill levels, our clinics offer a chance to build confidence, learn from certified coaches, and fall in love with the game—all while making new friends and staying active.

Held throughout the year at rotating indoor and outdoor locations, each clinic focuses on technical development, teamwork, and game play in a short, accessible format.

blocks.text: 🚀 What to Expect

blocks.html:
Each clinic follows a consistent, proven structure to maximize development in a short time:

  • Dynamic Warm-Ups & Stretching

  • Skills Instruction (dribbling, passing, shooting, defending)

  • Soccer-Based Games (Teqball, Soccer Volleyball, Capture the Flag)

  • Small-Sided Scrimmages

  • Player Check-Ins & Progress Tracking

Clinics typically run 90–120 minutes and are offered as stand-alone sessions or mini-series across weekends, school breaks, and summer.

Players will leave our clinics with:

  • Increased technical ability and confidence on the ball

  • Better understanding of the game and positional play

  • Improved fitness and coordination

  • Real-time feedback from experienced coaches

  • Social-emotional growth through teamwork and play

Ready to kick off with us? New players are welcome at every session.
Clinics are FREE 

Questions? 📧 remy@tekkerz.co

We work with schools, churches, leagues and park districts across the southside of Chicago to bring free and affordable soccer programming, including camps. From elementary beginners all the way to rising high schoolers looking for collegiate training. Our camps meet the players where they are and help them level up their game!

Camps are great for spring, summer and winter breaks! They generally run anywhere from 1 week to 1 month. Campers are guided by professionally trained coaches, focused on engaging development strategies and love for the game. Snacks, sunscreen, and a camp t-shirt are the cherry on top! blocks.html: MegCity Team Training is built to elevate your entire squad—whether you're a recreational team, travel squad, or high-level competitive program. Our team-focused sessions are tailored to your group’s needs, skill level, and season goals. We partner directly with coaches to co-design a program that accelerates player development, enhances team chemistry, and sharpens tactical understanding.

Each team training plan is fully customized. Sessions typically include:

  • Dynamic Warm-Ups & Functional Mobility

  • Technical Skill Development (passing, dribbling, shooting, etc.)

  • Tactical Drills (spacing, communication, defending, transitions)

  • Game-Based Situations & Decision-Making

  • Team Shape & Small-Sided Play

  • Optional Game Observation & Strategy Review

  • Coach Collaboration & Progress Check-Ins

Sessions range from 75–90 minutes depending on team age and level.

Esther Okuro (she/her)

Director of Training & Development

Hailing from Kenya, Esther brings 25 years of playing experience and a deep passion for the game. Her coaching journey began at Oakwood University as a Tactical Coach, where she helped lead the program’s transition to Division II and supported HBCU tournament development. Esther has coached with Major League Soccer clubs for four consecutive seasons, working with youth aged 2–14 across all skill levels.

She’s collaborated with coaches from the Premier League’s Fulham Academy, West Ham, and the Ireland National Football Association. A US Soccer–licensed coach and standout defender known for her interceptions and assists, Esther is committed to giving back through the game.

Ezra Owjang (he/him)

Director of Programming

Ezra is a former college soccer player at Oakwood University. He built his career through developing his skills in the streets, spending little time with a club or organization. Ezra has always been self taught and self-driven, having built business and jumping into technology consulting. He has always stayed involved in soccer through different avenues - volunteering as a coach, developing soccer programming for various organizations, and now leading Tekkerz programming.

Remy Schroeder (they/them)

Director of Operations

Remy brings a unique blend of experience across education, coaching, nonprofit management, and operations strategy. With a background in teaching and youth development, they have led both classroom and field-based programs that center growth, equity, and impact.

As a nonprofit leader and consultancy team member, Remy has designed and scaled programs that serve communities with intention and sustainability. At Tekkerz, they lead day-to-day operations, program development, and team coordination—ensuring every initiative runs with purpose, precision, and people at the center.

MegCity's Group Training sessions offer all athletes a dynamic path to faster growth, technical precision, and mental confidence—all within a collaborative team environment. Designed for players ages 2–80, these small group sessions (preferably 4-8 players) are structured to match skill level and developmental goals—whether participants are new to the game, prepping for tryouts, or chasing elite development.

Led by nationally certified, experienced coaches, each session provides focused instruction, peer learning opportunities, immediate feedback, and measurable progress in a high-energy, team-oriented setting.

Our group training sessions are structured to deliver high repetition, technical detail, and competitive intensity:

  • Dynamic Warm-Up & Stretching
  • Ball Mastery & Footwork
  • Passing & Receiving in Game-Like Scenarios
  • 1v1 and Small-Sided Attacking & Defending
  • Finishing & Shooting Mechanics
  • Competitive Small-Sided Games
  • Mental Conditioning & Game IQ
  • Communication & Teamwork Development
  • Cool-Down & Performance Review
  • Training recording via Veo

Each session runs 60–75 minutes. Packages are available for players seeking regular weekly sessions or intensive prep cycles.

Players in our group training program benefit from:

  • Rapid skill improvement and increased technical confidence
  • Enhanced communication and on-field awareness
  • Sharper decision-making under pressure
  • Competitive edge through peer-to-peer challenge
  • Physical conditioning and endurance

What is MegCity Hoops?

MegCity Hoops brings community basketball to the South Side — organized leagues for youth and adults, focused on real player development, affordable access, and games close to home. Pick the league that fits your age group below and register in a few minutes.

Who It's For

Middle School (ages 5–8), High School (ages 9–12), and an open Adult Drop-In league — pick the tier that matches the player.

What's Included

Weekly practices and games, a team jersey, and league-organized play. Adult drop-in is pay-per-session, no commitment.
